cause: Runtime cannot emit its authoritative deadline error until execution deadlineD fires, then onFinish/onCancel and UI cleanup run before serialization/write. Client previously stopped at exactlyD, racing and replacing the meaningful server error with a generic transport timeout.

contract.execution: Original valid supplied timeout/absolute deadline remainsD on the wire. Connection/retry/startup admission budget staysD.
contract.delivery: Only connected reply waiting gets one uniform fixed delivery cutoffD+100ms. It is never reset across partial chunks or MCP readiness/actual call because both retain the originalD.
contract.failure: A complete failure reply received byD+100ms is returned unchanged, preserving command diagnostics and cleanup acknowledgment. No command-specific formatting is fabricated by transport.
contract.success: A complete successful reply must arrive with its newline byD; later success is rejected conservatively because protocol has no authoritative server completion timestamp.
contract.cutoff: All complete replies must have receivedAt<=D+100ms before decoding; blocked or partial peers beyond it get generic deadline2.
contract.uncertainty: Rejected late success does not establish whether an action occurred, and can reject an operation completed beforeD but delivered late. No automatic retry or client-side cancellation was added.
contract.limits: This bounds connection/reply waiting, not a hard whole-call wall-clock proof: existing blocking writeAll is unchanged. No-explicit-budget blocking-read policy is unchanged.
